_comment: Edge smoothness floor, measured from the shipped weight maps. edgeRough is the staircase (higher is worse); edgeWidth is the transition in pixels. A build may not ship an edge rougher than these; width is held to an absolute 2.4 px rather than to the previous build, since a properly resolved boundary is both narrower and smoother. Set after the matte was allowed to reach the whole band - the warm-pixel veto removed, and the evidence guard restated as an invariant instead of a copy of the raw coverage - taking the mean from 100.2 to 87.4. Edited deliberately, with crops compared, never to make a red build green.
